reuse.why: Hooks into the existing assertNotLinkedElsewhere precondition that every provider's link function already calls before touching anything.

duplication.why: The closed-account check is written once and not repeated in any of the six link functions.

placement.why: The check runs at the right layer (the shared pre-link guard in server/accounts/app.ts), but it is put inside a function whose name says it checks for links elsewhere, rather than in its own guard or a renamed one.

scope.why: A single 11-line addition limited to the requested rule.

maintainability.why: Small and centralised; the only cost is that assertNotLinkedElsewhere now silently checks something its name does not describe.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link functions (GoCardless, SimpleFin, Pluggy, Fintegra, Akahu, EnableBanking) go through assertNotLinkedElsewhere, which now carries the check.

one_place.where: assertNotLinkedElsewhere in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by every link*Account handler before any change.
